content.text: Skip to main contentCloseDownload the AppGet your news faster with our mobile experienceInstallNow88°Thu95°Fri85°SearchSearchUser IconSign In or Create AccountWatchfacebook icontwitter iconACCESSIBILITYDC Weather: Sunday sunshine and seasonable temperaturesby First Alert Weather TeamSun, November 2, 2025 at 7:41 AM4VIEW ALL PHOTOSFall foliage near Dulles International Airport on Nov. 2, 2025 (7News)Comment on this story0CommentShare storySharetopics: DC weatherSunday sunshineSeasonable temperaturesWashington CommandersSeattle SeahawksStandard timeLight showersTemperature forecastRight arrowWASHINGTON (7News) — Sunday's weather in the D.C. area will be seasonable with near-average temperatures and plenty of sunshine. Winds will be light out of the east at 5 mph.The Washington Commanders play at home this evening against the Seattle Seahawks. Clouds will increase this evening as a weather-maker passes to the south.Washington Commanders Forecast.pngStandard time begins today with earlier sunrises and sunsets. By early December, the sun will set at 4:45 p.m. in Washington, D.C.Standard Time Begins.pngMonday morning will bring a few light showers, mainly southeast of D.C. Clouds should clear during the afternoon with high temperatures climbing to 65 degrees.The rest of the week stays dry with higher temperatures on Wednesday in the low 70s.
